notes: Cliopatria has no Mpondo kingdom. One page: Pondoland (the article Mpondo_Kingdom did not load: URL_NOT_FOUND). The page is thin: no founding date, no kings other than Faku in 1820, no Mfecane, no 1844 treaty, no Port St Johns cession of 1878, no area. The state is dated from 1820 because that is the first dated ruler action; it is certainly older. The af-07-a Cape dossier enters 'Mpondo kingdom' (a name, not this slug) for the 1886 and 1894 gains. Gazetteer names Pondoland and Xesibeland are used by the Cape dossier too (to be added). Capital is a stand-in.
